name: crt.sh certificate search
tier_rationale: Operated by Sectigo Limited, an established certificate authority with published terms (A8 trusted); P001 cond 2 'crt.sh open (Sectigo, trusted)' and P026 cond 2 'trusted - crt.sh (Sectigo)'.

reliability.justification: Searches public Certificate Transparency logs (append-only, cryptographically verifiable certificate records); the service itself is often slow or failing (502/503, timeouts), which reads 'could not verify', never 'no certificates' (P001 cond 4).

search.title: crt.sh certificate search (JSON output; identity, O=, SHA-256 queries; HTML report links)

terms.quote: Per-source terms in the registry: crt.sh open (Sectigo, trusted)

search.notes: Quote: binding council text (P001 cond 2); research C0002 terms '[gh_infra] Free public service run by Sectigo; no formal API ToS' (verified_live 200). crt.sh/?q=%25.{domain}&output=json&exclude=expired[&deduplicate=Y], ?q={sha256}&output=json, ?O={org}&output=json and report links ?q={domain} / ?q={cert_sha256}. A body truncated at the core 15 MB cap is partial, never complete (P001 cond 5). Brand mode q=%25{brand}%25 is opt-in (setting ct_brand_search) because the keyword discloses the brand (P001 cond 10). Upstream family ct-logs: crt.sh, ctl.shodan.io and Cert Spotter mirror the same public CT logs, so they never count as independent votes. Used by ct_logs, domain_ownership (graph facts only, no calls: P013 cond 1) and pivots_domain_dns (manual links).

notes: Shared seed for batches p1-G01-1, p2-G14-1, p9-G01-1 (P001, P013, P026): batches only extend it (crtsh__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). No published quota: timeout 60 s and 2 retries for the frequent 502/503 and timeouts (research C0002: 'Use 60s timeout, 2-3 retries with backoff, 24h cache'), always inside the module budget (P001 cond 4: default 30 s, setting max 90 s, AR05); concurrency 2 keeps parallel heavy queries off a fragile free service; ttl 24 h.
